<title level="1" pfs="">[Sporeback Frog](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3280)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

This burrowing frog digs itself into moist earth so poisonous moss and toxic mushrooms can grow on its body.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Animal](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43)): DC 20

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 18

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 15
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 5">[Sporeback Frog](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3280)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Large" />
<trait label="Animal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=531" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 151

**Perception** +12; [low-light vision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=69)

**Languages**

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=34) +10, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) +12, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) +13

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +4

**Dex** +3

**Con** +5

**Int** -4

**Wis** +2

**Cha** +1
</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 21 

**Fort** +15 

**Ref** +12 

**Will** +9 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 94

</row>

**Resistances**
[poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=669) 8

**Weaknesses**
[fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=604) 4

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 25 feet, burrow 20 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
jaws +13,
**Damage** 2d8+6 piercing plus [Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=45)

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
tongue +15 ([reach 15 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)),
**Damage** seed spores

**Seed Spores**   A creature hit by the sporeback frog's tongue Strike takes 1d6 [persistent poison damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) as fungal spores begin to grow.

**Soporific Spores** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([Mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106), [Poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126)) The sporeback frog shakes the plants and fungi on its back until they emit a cloud of spores in a 20-foot emanation. All creatures in the area must succeed a DC 22 Fortitude save or become [clumsy 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61) and [stupefied 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=94) for 1 minute (clumsy 3 and stupefied 3 on a critical failure). This ability can't be used again for 1d4 rounds.

</column>
